Package com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage

Class JobAttributes

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.JobAttributes
  • public class JobAttributes
extends Object
    Owns the attributes of a Job. Attributes are wire data: they are transmitted to the nJAMS server with the next log message of the job. This is deliberately a different facet than JobProperties, which is client-local key/value storage that is never transmitted. Obtain via job.attributes().

    • Method Detail

      • add

        public void add​(String key,
                String value)
        Adds an attribute to this job. The value is masked according to the data-masking configuration and limited to the configured payload limits before it is stored.
        Parameters:
        key - the key to set
        value - the value to set; null values are ignored
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the job has already ended — the final log message has been sent and a later change is never sent

      • get

        public String get​(String name)
        Returns the attribute value for the given name.
        Parameters:
        name - attribute name
        Returns:
        attribute value, or null if not present

      • getAll

        public Map<String,​String> getAll()
        Returns a detached copy of all attributes for this job. I.e., any modification on the returned map has no effect on this job instance!
        Returns:
        map of all attributes

      • has

        public boolean has​(String name)
        Returns whether the job contains an attribute for the given name.
        Parameters:
        name - attribute name to check
        Returns:
        true if found, false if not found
